Subject: Redwood testimonial — donation/credit logistics and receipt request

Hi Stephanie / Marissa —

Thanks again for featuring FastRetail on the Redwood site — the customer story looks great and our marketing team loved it. A quick ask: our procurement team needs paperwork to close this out. We have two preferred outcomes and are flexible on which you can do:

1) Redwood applies a $500 account credit to FastRetail Co.’s Redwood account (preferred for our internal billing), OR
2) Redwood makes a $500 donation on our behalf to a charity (City Youth Fund is our preferred charity) and provides a formal donation receipt addressed to FastRetail Co. for our audit records.

We also accepted the swag offer — I can send a ship-to address once you confirm what’s available.

Can you confirm which option works and whether you can send an invoice/receipt that our finance team can attach to the PO? I attached the final testimonial doc if useful.

Thanks,
Priya

Marissa / Sean —

Forwarding Priya’s ask. FastRetail is fine with either account credit or donation — they specifically asked for a donation receipt if we take that route. My recommended split (to keep runway for credits while doing good) is: $300 account credit + $200 donation to City Youth Fund. That keeps the customer happy and gives us a tidy promo credit accounting entry.

Questions for you:
- Can we apply a $300 credit to AR for FastRetail under deal DL-2027-0591?
- If we process the $200 donation, do we have an approved charity vendor (we’ve used CharityBridge in the past) and can we generate a donation receipt addressed to FastRetail Co.?
- Any tax/audit text the receipt should include (e.g., Redwood made payment on behalf of FastRetail)?

If you’re short on cycles, happy to do the coordination with finance and legal — I’ll loop in the customer once we have exact wording and the swag SKU list.

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Customer Advocacy | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
